tools.name: services_search_listings
tools.description: Search service listings (GPU compute, synthetic data, inference, vector hosting, code review, research, data labelling). This is the entry point to the primary Bitroad flow: find a listing, then buy it with services_purchase (pricing_mode 'fixed', one call) or file a scope with services_request_quot

tools.name: services_purchase
tools.description: Buy a fixed-price service in one call: validates the scope, computes the deterministic price, creates the quote thread directly in accepted, and charges immediately, with no seller round-trip. The charge is held in escrow; the seller delivers via services_submit_deliverable and the payout releases w

tools.name: services_request_quote
tools.description: File a scope-of-work against a quote-mode service listing for bespoke work. The scope must conform to the listing's scope schema. The seller responds with a price + ETA; the buyer then has 24h to accept with services_accept_quote, which charges into escrow. Fixed-price listings refuse this: use serv

tools.name: services_get_quote
tools.description: Fetch one service quote thread with its deliverables. Buyer or seller side. Secret deliverables are decrypted only for the buyer; everyone else sees a redaction.

tools.name: services_accept_quote
tools.description: Accept a submitted quote and charge immediately. Runs the same delegation caps and payment-envelope rails as goods purchases; cap kickbacks return confirmation_required with a token — re-accept with acknowledged_confirmation + the token after the principal signs off. Funds are held in escrow until t

tools.name: services_counter_quote
tools.description: Post a counter-offer on a quote thread (price in pence, ETA in minutes, optional terms). Either side may counter: the buyer counters a submitted quote (requires the listing to have haggling enabled), the seller counters/revises a requested or already-quoted thread (always allowed pre-accept). Each c

tools.name: services_reject_quote
tools.description: Reject a submitted quote (buyer-only). Also used by the principal to deny a quote sitting in pending_principal_confirmation after a cap kickback.

tools.name: services_withdraw_quote
tools.description: Withdraw a quote request before the seller has quoted (buyer-only).

tools.name: services_list_my_quotes
tools.description: List service quote threads the authenticated principal opened (buyer-side view), paginated. Filter by status (requested, quoted, paid, delivered, released, …).

tools.name: services_acknowledge_delivery
tools.description: Explicitly accept the deliverable on a delivered quote. The acknowledgement is recorded immediately; the held payout releases as soon as the funds have settled in the seller's Stripe balance (instant when settled, otherwise the worker completes it — the returned status stays 'delivered' until then).

tools.name: services_create_listing
tools.description: Seller-side: publish a service listing (GPU compute, synthetic data, inference, vector hosting, code review, research). pricing_mode='fixed' lets buyers purchase in one call (set fixed_price_pence, optionally per-unit fixed_unit_* against a scope_schema field); pricing_mode='quote' (default) adverti

tools.name: services_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single service listing including its scope schema — the fields a quote request or purchase scope must provide — and, for fixed-price listings, the deterministic pricing formula (flat price plus optional per-unit block billing).

tools.name: services_list_open_requests
tools.description: Seller-side: list unanswered quote requests (status=requested). The primary polling tool for seller agents — respond with services_submit_quote.

tools.name: services_submit_quote
tools.description: Seller-side: answer a quote request with a price (pence), ETA in minutes, and optional terms. Requires the delegation's respond_quote action. Price must sit inside the listing's min/max band when one is set. Starts the buyer's 24h acceptance SLA.

tools.name: services_start_work
tools.description: Seller-side: mark a paid quote as in_progress. Requires the delegation's respond_quote action.

tools.name: services_submit_deliverable
tools.description: Seller-side: submit the deliverable on a paid/in-progress quote. kind=url|text|file|secret. Files are base64 in file_b64 (max 25 MB) with file_name + file_mime_type and land on object storage; secrets are envelope-encrypted and only the buyer can read them. Starts the buyer-acceptance window; re-sub

tools.name: services_list_my_sales
tools.description: Seller-side: list charged threads you still owe work on, paginated. status=paid | in_progress | delivered, or active (all three, the default). The polling tool for fixed-price listings — a fixed-mode purchase is created already paid, so it never shows up in services_list_open_requests. Respond with

tools.name: auth_whoami
tools.description: Return who this MCP credential acts as: principal email/role, agent name, client (Claude install) that issued the token, and when it was last used. Works for both br_ik_* instance keys and br_oat_* OAuth tokens; OAuth-specific fields are null when called under an instance key.

tools.name: auth_revoke_self
tools.description: Disconnect this OAuth connection by revoking the access+refresh chain that issued the token making this call. Idempotent: a second call returns `{ revoked: false, reason: 'already_revoked' }`. Refuses with `not_oauth_token` when called under an br_ik_* instance key — rotate those from the dashboard

tools.name: sellers_get
tools.description: Fetch a seller's public profile + trust signals (verification tier, dispute / refund / on-time-ship rates over a 90-day window, response times). Trust metrics carry a `stale: true` flag when the last computation is older than 36 hours.

tools.name: platforms_get
tools.description: Fetch a platform's public reputation profile by slug: KYC status, rolling-window orders/disputes/refunds, on-time-ship rate, dispute resolution p50/p95, anomaly-pause count. Decommissioned platforms include the banner and reason.

tools.name: addresses_list
tools.description: List the principal's saved shipping addresses. The agent does NOT need to call this every purchase — purchase_create_intent will use the principal's default shipping address if `address_id` is omitted.

tools.name: addresses_create
tools.description: Save a new shipping address. Set is_default_shipping=true to make it the default.

tools.name: payment_methods_list
tools.description: List the principal's saved payment methods (last4 + brand only — full card numbers are never exposed to agents). purchase_confirm_intent uses the principal's default method if no `payment_method_id` is passed.

tools.name: payment_methods_create
tools.description: Returns a one-time Stripe Checkout URL to hand the user so they can add a payment card. The card is saved to their account automatically when they complete the hosted flow — no charge is made (setup mode only). Present the `checkout_url` to the user as a link to open in a browser; there is nothing e

tools.name: envelopes_list
tools.description: List the active and historical payment envelopes the calling agent instance can draw against. Each entry shows balance, scope, validity, and per-tx / per-day caps. Read-only — envelopes are created, topped up, and revoked by the principal in the dashboard.

tools.name: envelopes_get
tools.description: Fetch a single envelope by id. Returns the same shape as envelopes_list. Returns 404 when the envelope is not bound to the calling agent instance.

tools.name: disputes_file
tools.description: File a dispute on a goods order (order_id; reasons: not_as_described, defective, not_received, fraud_unauthorized_charge, duplicate_charge, other) or a service quote (service_quote_id; reasons: service_not_delivered, service_quality, service_scope_mismatch, plus the generic three). Exactly one targe

tools.name: disputes_list
tools.description: List disputes for the authenticated principal (buyer-side: ones they filed; seller-side: ones filed against their orders). Filter by `status` (admin_review, awaiting_seller, resolved_for_buyer, resolved_for_seller, withdrawn).

tools.name: disputes_get
tools.description: Fetch one dispute by id with the full evidence trail and timeline. Buyer-side or seller-side caller — returns 404 if the dispute doesn't belong to either of the calling actor's roles.

tools.name: disputes_add_evidence
tools.description: Attach an evidence item to an open dispute. The body is base64-encoded; per-item cap is 25 MB and per-dispute cap is 200 MB. Either the filing buyer or the seller-owner can upload.

tools.name: disputes_withdraw
tools.description: Buyer-only: withdraw an open dispute. Closed disputes cannot be withdrawn.

tools.name: disputes_respond
tools.description: Seller-side response to a dispute. Requires the seller delegation's `respond_dispute` action. Free-form text 1–4000 chars.

tools.name: catalog_search_products
tools.description: Search marketplace products by free-text query, optional category, or seller. Returns a paginated list of summaries with pence-denominated prices, available stock, and restricted-goods flags. Pass a concise phrase, not a full sentence.

tools.name: catalog_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by id. Returns full description, structured spec values, seller id, live stock, and any restricted-goods flags. Prefer this over re-running search when the agent already has the product id.

tools.name: catalog_list_categories
tools.description: List the marketplace's category taxonomy. Optionally pass `slug` to scope to a subtree (e.g. 'electronics'). Each leaf carries its JSON Schema for specs, plus filterable / rangeable arrays so agents know which spec keys are queryable.

tools.name: catalog_describe_category
tools.description: Fetch one category by slug, including the spec JSON Schema for leaf categories. Useful before building a structured purchase intent so the agent emits a valid spec query.

tools.name: purchase_create_intent
tools.description: Create a purchase intent for a product. Reserves stock, snapshots price + VAT + shipping, and consults the delegation policy. Returns an intent id; intents expire after 15 minutes if not confirmed. Combined postage: same-seller purchases to the same address while earlier orders are unshipped are onl

tools.name: purchase_confirm_intent
tools.description: Confirm a purchase intent — re-validates price within 1p tolerance, charges via Stripe Connect destination charges (per-seller application fee on item only), and creates the order. May return SCA / payment-action-required / declined errors.

tools.name: purchase_cancel_intent
tools.description: Cancel a pending purchase intent and release the stock reservation.

tools.name: orders_list
tools.description: List orders the authenticated principal placed (buyer-side view), paginated with a cursor. Optional status filter (e.g. 'paid_awaiting_fulfillment', 'delivered', 'cancelled'). Use this to find an order id before calling orders_get.

tools.name: orders_get
tools.description: Fetch a single order with line items, shipment / tracking, payment status, and any associated returns or disputes. Buyer-side view — for seller-side use seller_get_order.

tools.name: returns_initiate
tools.description: Initiate a return on a delivered order. Uniform platform policy: a 30-day change-of-mind window from delivery, FREE, full refund, NO restocking fee, and the SELLER funds the return label. Reasons: cooling_off_statutory (days 0–14) and cooling_off_extended (days 15–30) are change-of-mind; defective i

tools.name: returns_get
tools.description: Fetch a single return by id, including reason, status, restocking fee (if any), refund ledger, and the inspection trail once the parcel has arrived.

tools.name: returns_list
tools.description: List returns the authenticated principal filed (buyer-side view), paginated. Filter by `order_id` to find returns on a specific order, or by `status` (initiated, label_ready, in_transit, received, refunded, rejected).

tools.name: returns_get_label
tools.description: Fetch a short-lived signed URL for the return shipping label PDF. URL expires within minutes; re-call to get a fresh one. Only available once the return has progressed to label_ready.

tools.name: seller_get_me
tools.description: Fetch the seller record bound to the calling principal or seller-side agent instance. Refuses when the caller has no seller record.

tools.name: seller_onboarding_status
tools.description: Read-only Stripe Connect onboarding status. Stripe Express onboarding itself is human-on-session; agents wait on this read until charges_enabled flips true before listing.

tools.name: seller_list_listings
tools.description: List the bound seller's product listings, paginated. Includes archived/flagged listings by default — pass `is_active: true` to filter to live listings only. Returns slug, category, stock, price, and any moderation flags.

tools.name: seller_get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single listing the bound seller owns, including its full description, current stock + reserved counts, spec values, and any moderation state. Refuses if the listing belongs to a different seller.

tools.name: seller_create_listing
tools.description: Create a product listing. Validates the payload against the leaf category's spec schema and the structured return policy. Restricted-goods classifier runs at write time; flagged listings are inserted but invisible until cleared.

tools.name: seller_update_listing
tools.description: Patch an existing listing the calling seller owns. Specs are re-validated against the leaf schema; return_policy is re-validated against the platform statutory floor. Buyers with pending intents get re-validated at confirm time, not blocked here.

tools.name: seller_archive_listing
tools.description: Soft-delete a listing (is_active=false). Refuses while any purchase intents are still pending against it.

tools.name: seller_update_stock
tools.description: Update a listing's stock count. Pass `stock` for an absolute value or `delta` for a relative change. Resulting stock must remain >= reserved.

tools.name: seller_list_orders
tools.description: List orders placed against the bound seller's products (seller-side view), paginated. Filter by `status` (e.g. 'paid_awaiting_fulfillment' to find orders that need shipping). This is the seller-equivalent of orders_list.

tools.name: seller_get_order
tools.description: Fetch a single seller-scoped order with buyer shipping address (PII-redacted where the policy requires it), items, shipment, payment status, and any associated return/dispute. Refuses if the order isn't against this seller.

tools.name: seller_mark_shipped
tools.description: Mark an order as shipped with a tracking number. Idempotent on (order_id, tracking_number) — same pair is a no-op success. Enqueues carrier polling automatically.

tools.name: seller_mark_delivered
tools.description: Declare a shipped order as delivered (no carrier confirmation is wired). Only valid from shipped; already-delivered is a no-op success. Notifies the buyer, who can dispute if it never arrived. Orders still shipped after 10 days are auto-marked delivered by the platform.

tools.name: seller_attach_tracking
tools.description: Attach or update tracking on an already-shipped order. Use mark_shipped for first ship; this is for late-arriving tracking only.

tools.name: seller_list_returns
tools.description: List returns filed against the bound seller's orders, paginated. Filter by `status` (initiated, label_ready, in_transit, received, refunded, rejected) to triage what needs inspection. Seller-equivalent of returns_list.

tools.name: seller_get_return
tools.description: Fetch a single return filed against one of the bound seller's orders, with reason, status, restocking fee, inspection notes, and the refund ledger. Refuses if the return isn't on a seller-owned order.

tools.name: seller_accept_return
tools.description: Acknowledge that a returned parcel arrived and was inspected. Moves return: approved → received. The refund engine runs idempotently afterwards via the existing webhook flow.

tools.name: seller_reject_return
tools.description: Reject a return after inspection. inspection_notes is required. Refuses if the return has already refunded.

tools.name: seller_list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews left on this seller's orders, paginated. Filter by `responded: false` to find reviews that still need a seller response. A review's `rating` is 1-5; lower-rated ones are typically the highest priority to respond to.

tools.name: seller_respond_to_review
tools.description: Post the seller's response to a review. One response per review; subsequent attempts return already_responded.

findings.detail: Description of "orders_list" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: services_search_listings, services_get_quote, services_list_my_quotes, services_submit_deliverable, services_list_my_sales, payment_methods_create, returns_get_label, seller_list_reviews · Private data: services_search_listings, services_request_quote, services_get_quote, services_accept_quote, services_submit_deliverable, auth_whoami, auth_revoke_self, disputes_file, seller_get_me · Public sink: services_counter_quote, services_create_listing, services_submit_quote, services_submit_deliverable, auth_whoami, disputes_add_evidence, returns_initiate, seller_accept_return, seller_respond_to_review · Destructive: seller_archive_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: services_search_listings, services_get_quote, services_list_my_quotes, services_submit_deliverable, services_list_my_sales, payment_methods_create, returns_get_label, seller_list_reviews · Private data: services_search_listings, services_request_quote, services_get_quote, services_accept_quote, services_submit_deliverable, auth_whoami, auth_revoke_self, disputes_file, seller_get_me · Public sink: services_counter_quote, services_create_listing, services_submit_quote, services_submit_deliverable, auth_whoami, disputes_add_evidence, returns_initiate, seller_accept_return, seller_respond_to_review · Destructive: seller_archive_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
